title: Recording: Golden Blunders, Everybody Wins, Angel In Disguise by Ringo Starr | 1991
content:
Bunny Hop Studios, Sherman Oaks
Producer: Peter Asher
Engineer: Frank Wolf

Ringo Starr worked on three songs for his tenth solo album, Time Takes Time, on 11 September 1991.

The backing track for ‘Golden Blunders’ had been recorded two days before, with more overdubs following on 12 and 13 September.

Also worked on was ‘Everybody Wins’, which was included on the ‘Don’t Go Where The Road Don’t Go’ CD single in September 1992. Starr re-recorded the song for 2010’s Y Not, retitling it ‘Everyone Wins’.

The day’s final song, ‘Angel In Disguise’, had also been started on 9 September. More overdubs were recorded on 12, 13, and 18 September, but the song, a co-write by Starr and Paul McCartney, was left unreleased.
